SURAJ SINGH RAJPUT 

Cinematographer  •  Videographer  •  Video Editor 

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India   | +91 89611 91217 | workwithsuraj30@gmail.com  | Linkedin 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY  

Cinematographer, videographer, and video editor with 5+ years of experience creating high-quality visual content from concept 

to final delivery. Worked with leading brands including Flipkart, Samsung, Zomato, TVS, Gujarat Titans, Rare Rabbit, Brigade,  

Embassy, Orion Malls, Ferrero, Fhenix India, Grant Thornton, and many more across lifestyle, real estate, sports, D2C, and 

corporate sectors. Produced 100+ commercial and social-first videos, generating 4 million+ organic views across brand platforms, 

with multiple reels individually surpassing 300K+ views. Skilled in cinematography, multicamera production, video editing, color 

grading, motion graphics, and AI-powered creative workflows, with a strong eye for visual storytelling and branddriven content. 

 

WORK EXPERIENCE  

Webenza  

Senior Cinematographer · Bengaluru | Feb 2026 | Present     

• Directed and shot 50+ commercial video campaigns for brands including Orion Malls and The Bay at Ecoworld, managing 
the entire production process from concept to final delivery. 

•  Created AI-powered marketing videos for brands such as Airtel and Dr. Fixit using AI workflows to speed up production 
while maintaining creative quality.  

• Led multi-camera productions, coordinating with directors, producers, clients, and on-set crews to deliver projects on 
time and in line with brand objectives. Ensured high standards in video editing, color grading, and final quality control, 
delivering visually consistent, brand-aligned content across all campaigns. 

Freelance — The Filmer Production | Ongoing, alongside full-time roles  

Cinematographer, Videographer & Video Editor · Bengaluru  

• Delivered independent video and photography projects for brands and organizations including Samsung, Rare Rabbit, 

Zomato, Em bassy, Gujarat Titans, Phenix India, TVS, Ferrera, Ajanta and My Digi Gold 

• Shot and produced content for the Kapil Dev – Grant Thornton Invitational golf event Managed each project end-to-end 
client briefing, shoot planning, filming, editing and final delivery — as founder of The Filmer Production  

Welkin Light Media ( Apr 2024 | Jan 2026 )  

Creative Head · Bengaluru 

• Led end-to-end creative strategy for 100+ video campaigns across brand accounts including Rare Rabbit, Brigade, Maison 

De Medusa, Watchcube, High Brew and Zomato. 

• Directed and shot content across product, real estate and F&B categories, reducing dependency on external production 

vendors. 

• Delivered a campaign for Hermitage India generating 300K–500K organic views with zero paid boost Managed a 

crossfunctional workflow spanning shooting, editing, motion graphics and graphic design; mentored junior crew 

members 

Rocktfuel Media ( Jul 2023 | Feb 2024 )   

Videographer & Video Editor · Bengaluru 

● Directed all production stages — scripting, storyboarding, casting, location scouting and crew management — for 
multiple brand clients over 8 months 

● Operated professional video gear (cameras, lighting, audio) to deliver broadcast-quality footage 

● Collaborated with creative teams to develop and test new content formats and shooting techniques 

Ruia Care – Multibrand Car Workshop ( Oct 2021 | Jan 2023)             

Video Producer, Editor & Social Media Manager · Kolkata 

● Managed end-to-end content pipeline for Instagram and YouTube — scripting, shooting, editing, publishing — as sole 
content creator for a multi-brand car service company 

● Produced videos and photography showcasing vehicles and service highlights, enhancing brand visibility and customer 
engagement 

● Directed pre- to post-production independently across 15 months, building full-stack production capability 

Chefrome ( Feb 2021 | Aug 2021)  

Video Producer · Kolkata 

● Managed and directed production elements including scripting, storyboarding, casting and location scouting for early-
career video projects 

● Operated professional video equipment (camera, lighting, audio) to capture high-quality footage 

● Collaborated with the team to brainstorm and implement new creative techniques 

 

workwithsuraj30@gmail.com
mailto:%20linkedin.com/in/suraj-singhrajput-4779a8227


 

SKILLS 

Technical Skills – Cinematography, Video Production, Motion Graphics, Photography, Pre & Post Production, Color Grading & 
Correction.

AI Tools – Copilot, ElevenLabs, Canva AI, Capcut AI.
